preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if len(line.split()) > 1)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of businesses N is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The input contains exactly N-1 lines of edges for each test case, forming a connected tree structure on N vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= val <= 10**9 for val in [int(x) for x in stdin_text.split() if x.isdigit()])
preconditions.description: All business values A_i are positive integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 5 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.
Each output line contains a single non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == max_damage(i) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output integer equals the maximum damage achievable by removing exactly one business, where damage is defined as the sum of GCDs of values in all connected components formed after removal.
